title_sq: Shesim Dyqan dhe 2 Garsoniere buze Rruges se Durresit, Tirane!
description_sq: Dyqan dhe 2 garsoniere te investuara ne katin 0 ne nje ndertese buze Rruges se Durresit, prane Ministrise se Arsimit. Prona perbehet nga nje dyqan 44m2 dhe nje 2 garsoniere me siperfaqe 85m2 dhe ambientet ndihmese. Dyqani ka vizibilitet shume te larte, me nje fasade 10m ne buze te rruges, aktualisht i dhene me qera me kontrate qe zgjat edhe 2 vjet e gjysem per cmimin 1500 euro/muaj. Garsonieret jane gjithashtu te dhena me qera me kontrate 5 vjecare per cmimin 650€ neto/muaj. Vendndodhja fare prane qendres e ben kete prone te pershtatshme per zhvillimin e cdo lloj aktiviteti si dhe per banim. Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
title_en: We are selling a shop and 2 studios on the edge of Durres Street, Tirana!
description_en: Store and 2 studios invested on the 0th floor in a building on the edge of Durres Street, near the Ministry of Education. The property consists of a 44m2 shop and 2 studios with an area of ​​85m2 and ancillary facilities. The store has very high visibility, with a 10m facade on the edge of the street, currently rented with a contract that lasts for 2 and a half years for the price of 1500 euros/month. The studios are also available for rent with 5-year contracts for the price of €650 net/month. The location very close to the center makes this property suitable for the development of any type of activity as well as for residence. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
